summary: With power-of-two enabled and radix disabled, the old guard incorrectly permits radix 16 and 32 to use multi-digit optimizations restricted to radixes <= 10, triggering a debug assertion. The fix checks power-of-two so these radixes use single-digit parsing. The fix extends algorithm_test in lexical-parse-integer/tests/algorithm_tests.rs with detecting assertions. Run that integration test with power-of-two enabled, radix and compact disabled, and debug assertions enabled. Reverse only the feature-guard line, preserving the macro rename and all tests.
